description: A minecraft mod for neoforge 1.21.1 that use XP for teleport.

mods.name: XPTeleport
mods.description: Distance-based XP teleportation mod with anti-abuse systems.

releases.notes:
New Settings and Tweaks:
- Gold Formatting Theme: Changed all command helper headings, active messages, and rankings from pink and aqua to gold.
- XP Leaderboard Improvements: Integrated the leaderboard directly under /xpteleport leaderboard and removed the separate /xp leaderboard command. Modified the sorting algorithm to prioritize experience levels over total accumulated XP points.
- Branding Enhancements: Replaced legacy implementation details in /xpteleport info with a clean Bistro credits string, and removed all remaining FTB Essentials code references.

Jar Naming:
- Dynamic Jar Naming: Configured the build process to include the mod version in the output jar file name (e.g. xpteleport-1.1.1.jar).

releases.notes:
XP Teleport v1.1.0

New Settings and Tweaks:
- Custom Timeouts: You can configure TPA request, map teleport, and leaderboard refresh durations in XptpConfig.
- New Configurations: Added tpa_request_timeout_seconds, xaero_confirm_timeout_seconds, and leaderboard_refresh_seconds settings.
- Name Protection: Home and warp creation now only accept alphanumeric names and underscores to prevent invalid entry errors.
- XP Limit: Trades using /xpgive or /xprequest are capped at 10000 levels to prevent level overflows.
- Warmup Alerts: Starting a new teleport cancels any active warmup and notifies the player instead of overwriting silently in WarmupManager.

Crash and Bug Prevention:
- Safe Atomic Saves: Data and config files write to a temporary file first and rename atomically, preventing file corruption on crashes.
- Leaderboard Stability: Fixed thread safety issues in LeaderboardManager that caused concurrent modification errors.
- Safe Random Teleports: Added error handlers to /rtp in TeleportCommands to prevent search locks if chunk loading throws exceptions.

Code Cleanup:
- Decoupled Commands: Split the large main file into smaller files like HomeCommands and TpaCommands to make the code easier to maintain.
